title: Proportional shading limit where the neighbour's northern boundary is shared by several lots
text: Where an adjoining property shares a northern lot boundary with more than one lot including the development site, the limit of shading at C3.9.1 shall be cumulative and proportional to the length of the shared boundary/ies of the development site (refer Figure 3.9f). This does not apply to diagonally adjacent lots.

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 2 - Single Houses.pdf

notes: Applicant states that the shadow cast is within the Table 3.9a limit scaled by the share of the neighbour's northern boundary the site abuts (Figure 3.9f: 35% limit shared 3:1:1 over 50 m gives 15% / 5% / 5%). The proportional figure is not computed by the engine; C3.9.1 still tests the unscaled limit. Coding excludes R100-SL: Table 2.10a removes all 3.9 provisions for R100-SL, but its footnote restores them where the development abuts a property not coded R100-SL (not encoded).
